doc.title: Ada Rovatti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 13, 2022

title: Why people call her to record; Randy and Mike
summary: She says she is hired on her own sound and professionalism, not only as Randy Brecker's wife.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: You’ve got an impressive — I guess we’d call it a discography so far, with your own material and playing on other people’s recordings. Do you have a sense of why people call you to play on their recordings?

Well you know wooh, that’s a good one. Well you know with Randy yes it’s my husband and I’m the wife, but clearly if I couldn’t — you know a lot of people assume oh if she’s in the Brecker Brothers and plays with him, yes and no. Yes I’m the wife but clearly if I couldn’t play I wouldn’t be there. And I think he likes the idea that I have my own sounds and of course I would love to sound like Mike but nobody’s going to sound like Mike and I don’t — I keep trying to practice and be as good as him but I wanted to keep my own identity. So he always said that I have pretty strong sounds and identity and I wanted to keep working on that. I think I have a good attitude towards music, I take everybody every music seriously so any kind of a job that is asked, that I’ve been asked, I always spend time in order to understand what they want and try to do the best I can so I’m professional and I think I have something to say. I hope so.
